summary: Find two distinct indices in an array such that their values sum to a given target.
key_observations: For any number x, we are looking for its complement: target - x.
A brute-force check tests every pair (i, j) with i < j.
A hash map can store previously seen numbers and their indices, enabling O(1) lookup for the complement.

approaches.name: Brute Force
approaches.idea: Iterate through every pair of elements using nested loops and check if their sum equals target.
pseudocode: for j from i+1 to n-1:

approaches.name: Hash Map (One-Pass)
approaches.idea: Traverse the array once. For each element, compute its complement (target - nums[i]). If it exists in the hash map, return both indices; otherwise, store the current element and its index.
